original_text: Types of Tissues Simple epithelia  A single layer of cells, all touching basement membrane Classified according to cell type: Squamous-flattened cells Cuboidal cube-shaped cells Columnar cells resembling columns
explanation: Simple epithelia consist of a single layer of cells, where every cell is in direct contact with the basement membrane. Simple epithelia are classified into three types based on cell shape: 1) Squamous: thin, flattened cells. 2) Cuboidal: cube-shaped cells. 3) Columnar: tall, rectangular cells that resemble columns.

questions.q: Which cell shape in simple epithelia is correctly matched with its description?
questions.exp: Squamous cells are flattened, cuboidal cells are cube-shaped, and columnar cells resemble columns.
